title: WGPU Conformance Harness v1
problem: WGPU renderer conformance tests repeatedly open textures, render scenes, map readback buffers, and sample pixels in each integration-test crate. That duplication makes new semantic tests expensive to add and lets harness behavior drift across path/stroke/paint gates.

repro.summary: Path-related WGPU conformance tests should render and sample through one shared integration-test support module while preserving existing pixel assertions.
commands: cargo test -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test path_base_conformance --test path_stroke_style_v2_conformance --test path_paint_conformance --test path_material_paint_conformance -j 1

gates.name: path-conformance-batch
gates.command: cargo test -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test path_base_conformance --test path_stroke_style_v2_conformance --test path_paint_conformance --test path_material_paint_conformance -j 1

continue_policy.notes: The first path-related batch is complete. Start a narrower follow-on only if another test family clearly needs the same harness extraction.
